name: Universal Intermodal Services - Houston Terminal - Houston TX

fieldNotes.siteResolution: loadmatch.com directory lists the Universal Intermodal Services Houston terminal at 7800 E Little York Rd, Houston TX 77016; the address is also tied to Universal Truckload Service (both Universal Logistics Holdings companies). A drayage / intermodal terminal in NE Houston south of E Little York Rd, with residential to the W and open field to the E. Roster coords land in the yard; center locked at 29.87010,-95.28610.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The property fronts E Little York Rd with an OPEN, ungated yard apron. Street View (2025) of the road frontage shows no perimeter fence, no barrier arm, no sliding gate, and no checkpoint pinch-point - trucks drive straight off the public road into the yard. truckGate = false (flagged uncertain - the deep interior of the yard could not be walked, but the road-frontage entrance is clearly uncontrolled).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed at the entrance or anywhere along the road frontage. guardShack = false; remoteGs = false (no controlled gate).
fieldNotes.layout: A long terminal building with an M&R / maintenance operation runs N-S; a smaller secondary building sits to the S. South of the buildings is a very large compacted-gravel drayage yard packed with rows of chassis, containers and trailers.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The yard apron / internal drive from E Little York Rd runs a long way before the dock face and the deep yard - 3+ truck queue capacity. drivewayLong = true; postGateStaging = true (large paved/graveled internal holding area).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide open yard apron at the road frontage - ample unused width to add an express/bypass lane. fastLaneOpportunity = true.
fieldNotes.docks: The terminal building has a modest dock bank (~20 doors estimated) plus M&R bays; this is primarily a yard/drayage operation. dockDoors 10-25, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive chassis/container/trailer storage across the large south yard - heavy drop-yard character. dropArea 50+, dropYard = true.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Two buildings - the long terminal/M&R building and a smaller secondary building. multipleFacilities left false (not a campus of large buildings).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; drayage moves are by truck. railServed = false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site sits within the NE Houston metro industrial fabric with adjacent residential subdivision. Classified Urban.
